description: This file defines internal interfaces for test hooks related to Orleans runtime system targets, including methods for retrieving silo information, provider diagnostics, and grain registration status.

classes.name: ITestHooks
classes.description: Internal interface defining test hook methods for Orleans runtime, including silo and provider diagnostics, and grain management.

classes.name: ITestHooksSystemTarget
classes.description: Internal interface extending ITestHooks and ISystemTarget, representing a system target with test hook capabilities.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Retrieves the primary target silo address for a given key in the consistent ring.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingProviderDiagnosticInfo
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: HasStorageProvider
methods.description: Checks if a storage provider with the given name exists.

methods.name: HasStreamProvider
methods.description: Checks if a stream provider with the given name exists.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainForTesting
methods.description: Unregisters a grain for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns an approximate mapping of silo addresses to their statuses.
